title: Indian Sneaker Festival
summary: A night-city street standoff built to promote the Indian Sneaker Festival.
description: A key visual pairing custom-lit sports cars with bold street typography, staged in a photoreal city environment to capture the energy of the Indian Sneaker Festival's automotive and streetwear crossover.

cover.alt: Two customized sports cars facing off on a city street at night with festival signage
